latestPost.text: We believe the Sovereign AI revolution is the most important movement since the advent of LLMs. This is a rebellion against the harvesting and migration of institutions’ and individuals’ data into the weights of closed models, only for their own knowledge to be rented back or used to replace them. It is a rebellion against the statistical tendency of these models towards the average and mediocrity. We believe every great institution is differentiated, and sovereignty is what enables that institution to own, protect, and compound its differentiation. We are the leader because we have been doing this for twenty years. Everything we have built has been in service of giving institutions maximal control over their operations, data, decisions, and their future. We are the sovereignty company. We do not exist by extracting value from our customers. We are confident enough to take on the risk of failure, and unlike any other company, we succeed only when our customers do. We are pushing the frontier and creating genuine impact in the world’s most important institutions. Thank you to all the Palantirians currently building, to our hundreds of commercial and government partners around the world, and to those who paved the way. The revolution is just beginning. latestPost.text: Need to find a fall internship, study for an upcoming admissions exam or master a new skill? Here are 10 ways our AI tools can help ↓ 🗓️ Build a dashboard to track internship opportunities and application deadlines using Canvas in AI Mode. Simply open AI Mode and turn on the Canvas tool to open a dedicated workspace. Then try a conversational prompt, like: “Build me a dashboard to find information on fall internships in NYC focused on marketing and communications in fashion. Include details on deadlines and application requirements.” 🎤 Prep for upcoming interviews by rehearsing with Gemini Live. You can have a natural, free-flowing conversation out loud — just like you would in an interview. Plus, you can ask the @GeminiApp for real-time feedback on your delivery, pacing and tone. ✏️ Create custom study guides for summer courses using AI Mode in Search. Just select the Canvas tool from the plus (+) menu and ask AI Mode in Search to make you a comprehensive study guide, complete with relevant links and images. You can then ask follow-up questions, upload your notes to add more context and share a link to the guide with your classmates or export it to @googledocs. 📹 Explore a hobby or pick up a new creative project with YouTube Learning. On select @YouTube videos, you can tap the “Ask” button to get a summary of its key points and even create a brief quiz on its contents — all without leaving the video. 🎓 Prep for tests with study notebooks in Gemini. After assessing your knowledge gaps with a diagnostic quiz, Gemini will keep you on track with bite-sized lessons and progress checks. 🔎 Learn a new skill with Search Live. Just open the Google app and tap the Live icon under the search bar. Then point your camera at anything in your environment you want to know more about. Try asking for advice or for tips on how to use certain tools or equipment. 🎧 Turn your notes into a podcast with Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM). Upload your notes, then use the Audio Overview feature to create a podcast between two AI hosts discussing your notes. You can even interrupt the hosts with questions if you don’t understand something. 📃 Workshop your resume and cover letter with Gemini Notebook. Create a notebook for your job or internship search, then upload all your career clutter — like old projects, positive feedback and resumes. @Gemini_Notebook can fine-tune your application materials, identify key strengths, and turn your background experience into a coherent narrative that you can pitch to employers. ⚽ Get instant feedback on your sports form with Gemini video analysis. Record a quick clip of yourself in action, and ask Gemini how you can improve. 🧠 Brainstorm internship options and explore possible job opportunities with Career Dreamer. Just input your experiences, skills and interests and find potential career paths tailored to your background.
